rows.description: My ex keeps texting, calling, or turning up after I said it is over and I feel uneasy. I state one clear final boundary, do not engage further, keep records, inform trusted people, and seek help from authorities if it continues.

rows.description: Years later I feel ready to forgive an ex. I release resentment for my own peace and can say so briefly if it helps, without reopening the relationship or needing their apology first.
